name: dokploy
title: Dokploy
description: Deploy Anywhere with Total Freedom and Ease.
author: xmok

commands.name: instances
commands.title: Instances
commands.description: Manage Instances and their Projects, Services and more

commands.name: deploy-service
commands.title: Deploy Service
commands.description: Search for a service by name across all configured instances and deploy the one you pick

commands.name: deployments
commands.title: Deployments
commands.description: See the most recent deployment for every application and Compose stack across every configured instance, and act on it

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Server Health
commands.description: Menu bar server health/disk status across every configured instance

preferences.name: diskThreshold
preferences.title: Disk Warning Threshold
preferences.description: Tint the menu bar icon when any instance's disk usage is at or above this percentage.

preferences.name: showIcon
preferences.title: Show Menu Bar Icon
preferences.description: Uncheck to hide the Server Health icon from the menu bar.
preferences.label: Show icon

tools.name: list-instances
tools.title: List Instances
tools.description: List the Dokploy instances configured in this extension.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List every project across the configured Dokploy instance(s), with each project's environments and how many services each holds.

tools.name: list-services
tools.title: List Services
tools.description: List every application, database, and Compose stack across the configured Dokploy instance(s), optionally filtered by instance, project, or kind.

tools.name: get-service
tools.title: Get Service
tools.description: Get the details of one Dokploy service: what it builds from, its domains, and its current status.

tools.name: get-service-logs
tools.title: Get Service Logs
tools.description: Read the runtime log of a Dokploy service - what the container is currently printing.

tools.name: list-deployments
tools.title: List Deployments
tools.description: List the build history of a Dokploy application or Compose stack: what was deployed, when, and whether it failed.

tools.name: get-deployment-logs
tools.title: Get Deployment Logs
tools.description: Read the build log of a Dokploy deployment - the log to check when a deploy failed.

evals.input: @dokploy What instances do I have connected?
@dokploy Give me the details for the api service
@dokploy Show me the logs for the api service
@dokploy Why did the api deploy fail?

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
